$comment: BET-5 band mode (Brothers Lazaroff and any band tenant): the gig panel, set lengths, segues and singer keys in the setlist editor, Perform and print. Times are 24-hour; lengths are minutes:seconds.
durationInvalid: Type a length as minutes:seconds, like 3:45
segueToggle: Runs straight into the next song
segueMark: Runs straight into the next song
setTargetsHint: Target minutes for each set. Leave a set empty for no target.
gigInvalid: Times are 24-hour, like 19:30. Set lengths are whole minutes.
showSheetHint: One page: venue, times, sets, keys, segues and lengths.
showSheetFailed: The show sheet could not be made. Try again.
